sources.title: Sample Development Review Manual, ADU Intake Checklist
sources.citation: Sample Development Review Manual Â§4.2 (ADU Intake)
sources.text: An accessory dwelling unit pre-application is reviewed first by planning staff for siting, setbacks and parking, then routed to building review once zoning clearance is issued.

sources.title: Sample Development Review Manual, ADU Zoning Review
sources.citation: Sample Development Review Manual Â§4.5 (ADU Zoning Review)
sources.text: Zoning review of an accessory dwelling unit checks lot coverage, rear and side setbacks, and access to a public street; it is a discretionary review step staff complete after a complete submittal.

sources.title: Sample Building Division Intake Guide
sources.citation: Sample Building Division Intake Guide Â§2.1
sources.text: Building permit intake for a residential addition requires a site plan, floor plan, scope of work and energy compliance documentation; residential additions are typically reviewed within three weeks.

sources.title: Sample Building Division Intake Guide, Tenant Improvements
sources.citation: Sample Building Division Intake Guide Â§5.4
sources.text: A commercial tenant improvement is routed to fire and life-safety review when the scope adds or relocates occupancy; plan review follows a complete submittal.

sources.title: Sample Development Services Intake Guide, General Submittals
sources.citation: Sample Development Services Intake Guide Â§1.1
sources.text: General pre-application submittals are triaged by intake staff, who assign the official permit type before any formal review begins.

sources.title: Sample Adopted Fee Schedule, Residential
sources.citation: Sample Adopted Fee Schedule Â§3 (Residential), ADU line
sources.text: Accessory dwelling unit zoning review: 185.00; accessory dwelling unit building review: 420.00. Fees are adopted by resolution and staff confirm the applicable amount at intake.

sources.text: Accessory dwelling units are permitted in residential zones subject to maximum size, setback and parking standards.
